_comment: Built-in budget recipes used when no recipe API is configured (RECIPE_SOURCE=catalog). One serving each. Prices are estimated US grocery costs per serving in dollars; macros are approximate grams per serving. A three-meal week needs at least 7 breakfasts and 14 mains for every meal to differ. Review prices each semester.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana oats
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk or water for about 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the peanut butter and cinnamon.
Top with the sliced banana.

recipes.title: Scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Cook the eggs in the butter over low heat, stirring gently, until just set.
Serve on the toast.

recipes.title: Greek yogurt with oats and berries
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the oats and berries.
Drizzle with honey.

recipes.title: Egg and bean breakfast burrito
steps: Warm the beans in a pan.
Scramble the eggs.
Fill the tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa, then roll it up.

recipes.title: Overnight oats
steps: Stir everything together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Eat cold or warm it up.

recipes.title: Two-ingredient banana pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and whisk in the eggs.
Cook small pancakes in the oiled pan over medium heat, about 1 minute per side.

recipes.title: Cottage cheese and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with cottage cheese.
Top with tomato and season.

recipes.title: Spinach and cheese omelette
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oiled pan.
Pour in the whisked eggs and cook until almost set.
Add the cheese, fold, and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut butter toast and a glass of milk
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Serve with the milk.

recipes.title: Lentil curry with rice
steps: Soften the onion in the oil.
Add the curry powder, lentils, tomatoes, and 1 cup water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Black bean chili
steps: Cook the onion until soft.
Add the beans, tomatoes, corn, and chili powder.
Simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg fried rice
steps: Stir-fry the vegetables in the oil for 2 minutes.
Push them aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot.

recipes.title: Chickpea and spinach stew
steps: Fry the garlic and cumin in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the chickpeas and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Chicken rice bowl
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces and cook in the oil until done.
Steam or microwave the broccoli.
Serve the chicken and broccoli over rice with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Ground turkey pasta
steps: Boil the pasta.
Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Stir in the sauce and toss with the drained pasta.

recipes.title: Tuna pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last minute.
Drain and cool.
Mix with the tuna, mayo, and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Chicken burrito bowl
steps: Season and cook the chicken, then slice it.
Warm the beans.
Layer the rice, beans, chicken, and salsa in a bowl.

recipes.title: Tofu and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Brown the tofu in the oil.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan sausage and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425F.
Toss everything with the oil and paprika on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Bean and cheese quesadilla
steps: Spread the beans on one tortilla and top with cheese and the second tortilla.
Cook in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer.
Add the chicken and vegetables and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Baked potato with bean chili
steps: Prick the potato and microwave for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Warm the beans.
Split the potato and top with beans, yogurt, and green onion.

recipes.title: Pasta with peas and egg
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Whisk the egg with the parmesan.
Toss with the hot drained pasta off the heat until creamy, then season.

recipes.title: Canned salmon rice bowl
steps: Warm the rice.
Flake the salmon over it.
Add the cucumber and drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Vegetable ramen stir-fry
ingredients: 1 pack instant ramen (discard half the seasoning)
steps: Boil the noodles for 2 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the vegetables, then add the noodles, egg, and soy sauce.
Toss until the egg is cooked.
